run_sweep_setup: run the sweep setup tool to generate and save job configs for a hyperparameter sweep
sample_cfgs_with_seed: sample unique and valid model configs using a given RNG seed and sampler constraints
dump_cfg_to_file: dump a pycls config object to a YAML file at the specified path
review_sweep_setup_function: review the sweep_setup function that orchestrates multiprocessing config sampling and directory creation
refactor_sample_cfgs: refactor the sample_cfgs function to support additional model types beyond anynet, effnet, and regnet
